explanation.question_quote: Examination shows edematous oropharyngeal mucosa and enlarged tonsils with purulent exudate.
explanation.sentence: She has an acute febrile sore throat with purulent tonsillar exudate and tender cervical lymphadenopathy.
This presentation is typical of group A streptococcal pharyngitis, although clinical findings alone do not confirm the diagnosis.
Toxic shock syndrome is the best answer among the listed options: it can complicate severe group A streptococcal infection, although it is rare after uncomplicated pharyngitis.
Acute rheumatic fever is a classic delayed complication of untreated streptococcal pharyngitis, but its characteristic cardiac manifestation is valvulitis, not dilated cardiomyopathy.
